brief: Acme Corp, Globex. We sell project management software for design agencies.
name: Competitor watch
description: Every Monday morning: what changed at your competitors last week, what it means for you, and what to act on.

steps.prompt:
Find what changed in the last seven days at the companies named here: {{brief}}

Look for prices, new features and launches, people joining or leaving the top, funding and outages. Give the source address of each item. Say so when you found nothing.

Write the weekly note: the ACT items first, then the rest in one short list per company, with the sources. If nothing changed, say that in one line.
